definitions.scope: Re-examination of all 30 non-Shroud records in the existing detailed study register, plus the separately traced cross-paper sources. Available primary measurements are retained even without an author-computed alternative date. Access limits from the source register remain explicit.
definitions.support: Mechanistic support means agreement with an aging process; it is not validation of a numerical calendar equation.
definitions.contradiction: A direct contradiction needs the same defined observable, comparable protocol, applicable specimen and independent reference age. Non-matching measurements may challenge transferability without falsifying the original conditional formula.
definitions.no_age: An unavailable prediction remains blank, never zero error. No new normal-tail probabilities or pooled date-error SD are inferred from non-equivalent properties.
definitions.identity: Museum inventory plus lab ID is preferred. Same mummy or site is a weaker link. Conflicting publications remain separate/flagged.

formula_locator: Fanti & Malfi2014, eqs.3–8. Reference fibre L1mm,d15µm,RH50%. x is signed calendar year, not years before measurement.
strength_limit: Our exploratory transplant of the single strength equation, not the published five-parameter date. Tests are monotonic rather than cyclic; fibre selection differs; corrections use group means rather than individual measurements; printed ancient specimen/date attribution conflicts; the printed ancient age is beyond the calibration endpoint. These outputs are excluded from empirical dating SD, normal tails and authenticity odds.
ftir_limit: Our diagnostic of the single R3 equation (Fanti2013 eqs3/11), NOT the combined FTIR R4 clock or a validated laboratory redating. Plot captions show normalized R3; the printed equation is ambiguous about normalization, so both readings are displayed. Baselines are explicit alternatives, not a claimed reproduction of the 300-step env-secant procedure. Nature2021 used germanium ATR, Fanti used diamond ATR. Source cloth is brittle and cannot be isolated for tensile testing, so suitability under the original screening rules is unestablished. Do not treat preprocessing variants, repeated spectra or formula outputs as independent ancient cloths, empirical SD or authenticity odds.
ftir_integration: 1762 archived points per curve, ascending wavenumber after reversal. Linear interpolation at exact band boundaries, trapezoidal integration. Minimum shift subtracts the full-spectrum minimum; convex envelope subtracts the lower piecewise-linear convex hull; endpoint subtracts the full-range endpoint line. Endpoint produces negative band areas and no age is calculated. These are sensitivity checks, not assumed validated corrections.
xrd_limit: Cambridge raw and processed XRD spreadsheets retrieved and inspected: one-dimensional 2θ scans, not the specified De Caro 10-degree equatorial-sector WAXS profiles. Segal overall crystallinity and NMR crystallinity cannot replace the WAXS aging parameter (De Caro2019 Section3 explicitly distinguishes DP from crystallinity). Processed workbook Sheet2 assigns Ancient58.4084% / Modern59.6077%, while the Nature main text assigns ancient59.6% / modern58.4%; preserve this labeling discrepancy. No WAXS calendar date calculated.
